item.title: 2025 AMain Hobbies Black Friday Sale
item.description: It’s the holiday season, and Black Friday is about to bring some of the best deals of the year to AMain Hobbies. With savings on more than 20,000 products at AMainHobbies.com/blackfriday, there’s something for every RC driver, racer, and builder.

item.title: New Aerox Car Protection Bags
item.description: Schumacher RC is pleased to introduce these awesome new AEROX Car Bags.

item.title: New Revolution Design 64p Spur Gear Options
item.description: Ultra Spur Gears from Revolution Design deliver crisp, efficient drivetrain performance for 64dp applications.

item.title: New Aerox V3 Elite Series Batteries
item.description: Schumacher RC are pleased to bring you additional new LiPo's to the awesome AEROX V3 Elite range.

item.title: New Team Xray XB2 Extra Short 2mm Chassis
item.description: The Team Xray XB2 extra-short design with a wide rear section is specifically developed for ultra low-traction and slippery track conditions, especially on dirt and loose surfaces.

item.title: New OGO H and CH Compounds
item.description: OGO has unveiled its completely redesigned tire lineup, featuring a new Italian rubber compound that delivers greater elasticity, improved lateral grip, and more consistent performance.

item.title: 2025 US Indoor Champs Results
item.description: This past weekend Scotty Ernst's US Indoor Champs took place in Cleveland, Ohio, and annual gathering of the world's best carpet on-road racers as well as a Thanksgiving celebration. Find all the podiums here!

item.title: Sparko Signs Adrian Pariente
item.description: Adrian Pariente has signed with Sparko Racing for 2026 and started out the adventure with a win in the final round of the Spanish Championship in 1/8th Nitro Buggy.

item.title: New JConcepts JCI Endgame X-Maxx Body
item.description: The End Game by JConcepts is a fun and unique twist on outfitting the Traxxas X-Maxx to all-terrain basher with a clear ceiling not seen before in this genre.

item.title: New Team Saxo F1 Body and Accessories
item.description: Team Saxo has released their newest product a new 1/10 New F1 Body Shell with Helmet, Halo and Mirrors.
